content: Bio-Copper Based Dual-Action Barrier Spray Eliminating the "Hot Spots" and Fungal Colonies in Feed Storage Silos Modern feed storage faces a hidden enemy: condensation and moisture ingress. Even high-quality feed can be ruined by "hot spots"—mold colonies that grow on the internal walls and cone sections of silos. These colonies shed spores and dangerous mycotoxins into every batch of feed that passes through. As the industry shifts toward antibiotic-free production, maintaining a pathogen-free storage environment is just as critical as the feed formulation itself. Challenges Mold and bacteria (like Salmonella) thrive in the "sweat" on silo walls, contaminating fresh feed. Fungal growth causes feed to stick to the walls, leading to flow issues and the accumulation of old, rotting material. Even a small patch of mold in a silo can "seed" an entire shipment of feed with dangerous secondary metabolites. Untreated silo bases and seams act as magnets for insects and pests that carry diseases. Organic acids produced by mold can degrade the protective linings of metal and concrete silos over time. The Clean Silo Solution MaxDmold™ Spray is an advanced solution TM engineered to maintain the safety of feed MaxDmold ingredients during silo storage. It effectively bridges the gap between structural integrity and feed hygiene. By combining bioavailable Spray phyto-actives with mineral complexation, it creates a hostile environment for microbes while remaining completely free of harsh synthetic residues. Mode of Action Plant phytoactives destabilize fungal cell walls on silo surfaces, leading to leakage and rapid cell death. Inhibits key enzymatic pathways required for mold growth and replication within surface micro- crevices. Polyphenols induce an oxidative imbalance within fungal cells, preventing the formation of "hot spots". Bioactive copper enhances the persistence of the spray, ensuring uniform, long-lasting activity across silo walls and structural linings.
